content.article: Anyone who registers with Longfu88 is first pointed to the Casino Welcome Bonus. Its headline numbers are 188%, a ceiling of €2,088 and a gift of 18 Free Spins. Playthrough is set at 25x across deposit plus bonus, and the spin winnings are rolled over 40x separately. Beyond that opener, the Longfu bonus overview below takes in crypto and live casino deals, nine wagering terms and the sportsbook rewards. Figures are taken only from the Longfu88 listing. Players at Longfu88 must have reached 18, and this page is aimed at Singapore.

Offer Families as a Table

Promotions at Longfu88 can be sorted into families, and the family name already tells what an offer pays for before any number is read. The table lists eight casino promotions with the family of each. Three are greeting gifts for new customers: the standard casino one, the live casino one and the crypto one. Sportsbook bonuses are left for their own section further down the page.

Family Offer
Rebate Unlimited Casino Rebate
Match on the opening deposit Casino Welcome Bonus
Opening deal for live casino Live Casino Welcome Bonus
Opening deal paid in crypto Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus
Free spins renewed every week Casino Weekly Reload
Deposit bonus for the weekend Casino Weekend Reload
Part of weekly casino losses returned Casino Weekly Cashback
Part of live casino losses returned Live Casino Cashback

Switching on any of these eight happens in My Bonuses, so the activation routine does not change from one family to the next.

Longfu88 Welcome Bonus Options Compared

The three welcome offers share one trait: each is tied to the first deposit. Top of the Longfu88 list sits the Casino Welcome Bonus. A newly registered player who makes a qualifying first deposit is given a 188% match worth at most €2,088 along with a bundle of 18 Free Spins, and only one such welcome offer exists per account. Taking the Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus instead means skipping that one, as the two are alternatives for the opening deposit.

Offer Time allowed Entry deposit Prize
Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus Expires after 10 days 50 USDT 188% match, ceiling 2,888 USDT
Live Casino Welcome Bonus Expires after 7 days €30 125% match, ceiling €888
Casino Welcome Bonus Lapses 10 days from activation €50 188% match, ceiling €2,088, and 18 Free Spins

Put next to each other, the options at Longfu88 differ by currency, size of the cap and amount needed to start. Both 188% deals use the same percentage, but one stops at €2,088 and the other at 2,888 USDT. Free spins, which are slot rounds paid for by the casino, come only with the euro deal. Live casino players are offered 125% up to €888, can start with €30 instead of €50 and get the shortest validity, 7 days.

Claiming a Welcome Offer

Getting a welcome offer from Longfu88 means passing through four numbered stages in a set sequence. The activation in My Bonuses is the third, placed after the first qualifying deposit and ahead of the first bet.

  1. Sign up and supply the personal data that the registration form requires.
  2. Make the opening payment, a first deposit that satisfies the offer conditions.
  3. In My Bonuses, activate the Casino Welcome Bonus while no bet has been placed.
  4. Use eligible casino games to clear the wagering target before the offer runs out.

The offer lasts 10 days counted from activation. Within that span the playthrough, i.e. the turnover attached to the bonus, must be completed. Betting first and activating later is not possible.

Longfu88 Bonus Options for Crypto Players

Players who deposit coins rather than euro at Longfu88 turn to the Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus. Unlocking it takes a first crypto deposit worth 50 USDT or more, and the reward is a 188% match topping out at 2,888 USDT. Turnover required is 40x of deposit and bonus added together. Ten days of validity apply, and each spin made with bonus money is capped at 5 USDT. Entry is limited to registered players who meet the qualification rules written for this offer, and once those rules and the deposit conditions are satisfied, the bonus gets activated inside My Bonuses. Because this package and the euro Casino Welcome Bonus are alternatives, only one of them serves as the first-deposit deal.

Further crypto promotions at Longfu88 are two reloads, one running through the week and one at the weekend. Each needs just 20 USDT to qualify. In the weekend edition, 100 Free Spins are attached to the match.

Reload Playthrough Reward Entry deposit
Casino Weekly Crypto Reload 30x of deposit and bonus 60%, limit 1,000 USDT 20 USDT or more
Casino Weekend Crypto Reload 30x of deposit and bonus, then 40x of the winnings made on Free Spins 75%, with 100 Free Spins added, limit 750 USDT 20 USDT or more

Seven days is how long either reload remains valid. One claim per promotional period is allowed, and a reload excludes any other casino bonus that is active at the time. Spins played while bonus funds are wagered are limited to a €5 stake. In wagering alone do the pair part ways: the weekly reload stops at 30x of deposit and bonus, while the weekend reload piles a 40x condition on the Free Spins winnings.

BTC, ETH, LTC, BCH, XRP, USDC and USDT make up the seven coins this welcome bonus accepts.

Live Casino Bonuses in Full

Live dealer tables have a dedicated entry offer at Longfu88, called the Live Casino Welcome Bonus. New players receive it with the first qualifying deposit, at a rate of 125% and up to €888. A minimum of €30 must be paid in, wagering stands at 30x for deposit plus bonus, a week (7 days) is the validity window, and bets are capped at €25. Under the rules, My Bonuses is where the bonus gets activated, after eligibility and deposit conditions are in order, comes before any wagering and excludes parallel use of another active bonus.

On a weekly basis there is also the Live Casino Cashback. Its rate is 25% with a ceiling of €850. A cycle covers the stretch from 00:00 UTC on Monday up to 23:59 UTC on Sunday, and the figure reflects real-money stakes placed on qualifying Live Casino games, with the winnings from those games netted off. The result lands in My Bonuses on Monday. Players opt in, activate it and then play through 10x of the credited sum.

Daily returns come from the Unlimited Live Casino Rebate of 1.0%, which Longfu88 books to the rewards balance each day. Live play therefore has a weekly return and a daily one besides its welcome deal.

Wagering of Nine Offers Side by Side

No term varies as much between offers as the wagering, and it changes with the type of bonus too. Across the nine offers of Longfu88 shown here, the highest figure is 40x, applying to the crypto welcome bonus and to Free Spins winnings, while the lowest is 1x on the casino rebate, with 8x on the sports first deposit in between.

Playthrough Offer
8x deposit and bonus Sport First Deposit Bonus
1x rebate credited Unlimited Casino Rebate
10x cashback credited Casino Weekly Cashback
40x on spin winnings, 30x on deposit and bonus Casino Weekend Reload
30x deposit and bonus Casino Weekly Crypto Reload
40x Free Spins winnings Casino Weekly Reload
40x deposit and bonus Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus
30x deposit and bonus Live Casino Welcome Bonus
40x on spin winnings, 25x on deposit and bonus Casino Welcome Bonus

What the multiplier applies to is not constant either. In six rows it is deposit plus bonus, in a few it is Free Spins winnings, and in the rest it is the credited cashback or rebate. The offer's own line merits a look before activation.

Limits and Rules of the Main Offer

Four limits shape the Casino Welcome Bonus, the headline offer of Longfu88. First comes the wagering, which has two parts: deposit and bonus together must be wagered 25x, and the winnings from the Free Spins, meaning money won on those spins, carry a separate 40x multiple. Second, both requirements have to be completed within 10 days of activation, because that is the validity of the offer. Third, the largest bet allowed is €22.5 per spin. Last, cashing out is capped at 5x the original bonus amount, so the size of the bonus decides the ceiling on what it can ever pay out, however large the winnings turn out to be.

Minimum Deposit in Euro and USDT

What it takes to start differs by offer and by the currency of the deposit. Two offers at Longfu88 are priced in euro, at €50 and €30, whereas the three crypto offers are priced in USDT.

Offer Entry amount
Live Casino Welcome Bonus min. €30
Casino Weekend Crypto Reload min. 20 USDT
Casino Welcome Bonus min. €50
Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus min. 50 USDT
Casino Weekly Crypto Reload min. 20 USDT

The Casino Welcome Bonus cannot be claimed with Neteller or Skrill deposits. The casino-wide minimum deposit is another matter and does not replace what an offer asks, so the figure printed against the offer applies.

Reloads Week by Week

Reloads are aimed at players who come back to deposit mid-week or on the weekend. Longfu88 lists three: a weekly reload paid in USDT and two weekend reloads, one in euro and one in USDT.

Reload Prize Entry deposit Playthrough
Casino Weekend Reload €3,360 ceiling, 50 Free Spins included from €50 30x on deposit with bonus, 40x on what the spins win
Casino Weekend Crypto Reload 750 USDT ceiling at 75%, 100 Free Spins included from 20 USDT 30x on deposit with bonus, 40x on what the spins win
Casino Weekly Crypto Reload 1,000 USDT ceiling at 60% from 20 USDT 30x on deposit with bonus

Seven days of validity apply to all three. While bonus money is being played, a spin may not exceed €5, and no other active casino bonus can be held in parallel with a reload. The entry deposit follows the currency: €50 for the euro reload, whereas 20 USDT applies to both crypto reloads. Wagering follows the prize. The weekly crypto reload has a single 30x requirement attached, while Free Spins winnings add a 40x rollover to each weekend reload.

Weekly Cashback Without the Fine Print

Casino Weekly Cashback differs from the other casino offers in that it settles a week already played. What returns is a portion, 10% at most, of casino losses after winnings are deducted, and the payout stops at €6,988. Net loss means the total staked less the total won in one Monday-to-Sunday span, which starts at 00:00 UTC on Monday and ends at 23:59 UTC on Sunday. Where a Longfu88 reload answers a new deposit, this one answers the past seven days.

Only bets made with real money are taken into account, and anything wagered from bonus funds leaves the weekly figure untouched. The minimum cashback is €4.5. Joining happens through an opt-in that runs for a cycle of 4 weeks, and active accounts can roll into the next cycle automatically. After the credit, the cashback itself has to be wagered 10x before withdrawal, far less than the 25x-40x range of the welcome offers.

Rebates on Casino and Live Games

Qualifying real-money bets that have been settled earn a percentage back as a rebate, calculated per game category. Longfu88 shows four unlimited rebates, with percentages from 0.8% to 1.0%.

Rebate Share returned
Unlimited Lottery Rebate 1.0% returned
Unlimited P2P Rebate 0.8% returned
Unlimited Casino Rebate 0.9% returned
Unlimited Live Casino Rebate 1.0% returned

Each credit reaches the rewards balance daily with a 1x wagering requirement on the credited rebate. The return thus comes daily rather than once weekly, as cashback does.

Sports Bonuses Paid in USDT and Euro

Sports betting has its own set of bonuses at Longfu88, independent of the casino ones. Six are deposit-based (a first deposit, a welcome and four reloads), three of them in euro and three in USDT, and all six share the same playthrough, 8x of deposit and bonus.

Bonus Match and ceiling Entry
Sport First Deposit Bonus 100%, €1,888 at least €50
Sport Crypto Weekly Reload 50%, 500 USDT at least 20 USDT
Sport Weekend Reload Bonus 50%, €3,750 at least €50
Sport Weekly Reload Bonus 50%, €2,500 at least €50
Sport Crypto Welcome Bonus 100%, 200 USDT at least 20 USDT
Sport Crypto Weekend Reload 50%, 1,000 USDT at least 20 USDT

Every euro bonus in the table starts at €50, and every USDT bonus starts at 20 USDT. For wagering to progress, a sports bet must be settled and qualifying. Singles qualify from odds of 2.00, while in accumulators every individual selection has to carry odds of at least 1.50. A bet that gets voided, or one that is cashed out, does not count. The bonuses last 30 days, with one claim permitted in each promotional period stated. An 8x multiple is much lower than the 25x to 40x attached to the casino welcome offers.

Two more sports offers complement the deposit bonuses. Under Sports Cashback, 10% of the eligible sports net losses of a week comes back, capped at €2,500. The Parlay Boost lifts winnings from qualifying accumulators by as much as 100%.

Playing the Offers on a Phone

On a smartphone or tablet, the offers are reached through the browser, since Longfu88 is a responsive website. Bonuses belong to the mobile version, alongside deposits, withdrawals, login to the account, the sportsbook and the casino. Activation of an offer still takes place in My Bonuses. A fuller account of mobile access is given on the app page of the site.

Is a Code Needed for Crypto Offers?

No Longfu88 promo code appears in the brand information for any offer, which is why the crypto offers and the other bonuses here are described without one. A code is not what counts at Longfu88. The listed offers, whether in euro or in USDT, are enabled from the My Bonuses area when their deposit conditions are satisfied, and play on the Casino Welcome Bonus starts only after that step. Minimum deposit and wagering are set out offer by offer in the sections above.

content.title: Longfu88 Offers: Crypto and Live Questions

faqs.question: Can a crypto deposit earn a welcome offer?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus matches a qualifying first crypto deposit at 188%, with 2,888 USDT as the cap. A player takes either that or the euro Casino Welcome Bonus, since the two replace each other.

faqs.question: Do live dealer games come with a welcome offer of their own?
faqs.answer: They do, for newcomers who begin at the live tables. The Live Casino Welcome Bonus pays 125%, with a ceiling of €888.

faqs.question: Which deposit methods are barred from the welcome bonus?
faqs.answer: The excluded ones are Neteller and Skrill, so paying in with either rules out the Casino Welcome Bonus.

faqs.question: What size must the first deposit have?
faqs.answer: Claiming the Casino Welcome Bonus needs €50 at the very least, while the live casino offer needs €30.

faqs.question: Are sports bets covered by separate bonuses?
faqs.answer: Yes, the sportsbook keeps its own list, apart from the casino bonuses. An example is the Sport First Deposit Bonus of 100% up to €1,888.

faqs.question: Is a code required to claim any of this?
faqs.answer: A promo code is not part of the offers listed. What is required is activation in My Bonuses before the first wager on the Casino Welcome Bonus.

faqs.question: Who handles a bonus question?
faqs.answer: Contact goes through e-mail or through live chat at Longfu88, and the chat is open 24/7.
